(Currently amended) Claim 1: A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is defined to allow for a degree of deformation such that the fluid passage maintains a sealing engagement with varying tapered fluid conduit dimensions.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches at the sealing interface.

(Currently amended) Claim 7: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is defined to provide a sealing engagement with a tapered fluid conduit that accommodates tolerances in manufacturing.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal and is characterized by a stress-strain response that enables sealing under variable pressure conditions.

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal without damage to the chromatography column. 

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, under conditions of thermal or mechanical stress.
